source.name: Score and Change, Overview of the 2026/2027 La Liga sponsors
source.quote: This season, Barcelona has entered a five-year sleeve sponsorship deal with Midea (shirt sponsor of Sevilla last season).

note: Reported EUR12m a year over five years (the page reads 'reportedly pays EUR12 annually', i.e. per year); the end season 2030-31 is derived from 'five-year' starting 2026-27 and is not directly sourced.
